# HeFu API Doctor

> Free open-source browser tool for checking AI API protocol compatibility and generating client configuration without exporting prompts, model outputs or credentials.

HeFu API Doctor helps developers verify model IDs and response contracts before integrating an AI API. It supports HeFu OAuth with PKCE and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It also provides no-request Codex and n8n troubleshooting checklists and bilingual client-specific guides. The open-source tool, local preflight, troubleshooting and configuration generator are free; each live model request requires explicit user confirmation and may incur provider charges.

Important boundaries:

- HeFu OAuth supports OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages.
- Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints support Chat Completions and Responses, including keyless localhost servers.
- A successful result verifies only one non-streaming response structure, not model quality, streaming support or a production workload.
- OAuth tokens and custom keys stay in page memory. Reports exclude credentials, endpoint URLs, prompts and model outputs.

## Client troubleshooting guides

- [Codex custom provider 404: Responses API checklist](https://hefu.hk/api-doctor/guides/codex-responses-404/): Diagnose why cURL Chat Completions can work while Codex fails, and check base_url, Responses support and model access.
- [Codex 中文排障指南](https://hefu.hk/api-doctor/zh-cn/guides/codex-responses-404/): Codex 自定义 Provider 404、Responses、base_url 与模型权限检查。
- [n8n OpenAI-compatible model node 404 checklist](https://hefu.hk/api-doctor/guides/n8n-openai-compatible-404/): Compare HTTP Request and model-node Base URL, model ID, Responses settings, tools and retries.
- [n8n 中文排障指南](https://hefu.hk/api-doctor/zh-cn/guides/n8n-openai-compatible-404/): HTTP Request 成功但模型节点 404 的分步检查。

## Product and source

- [Product overview](https://hefu.hk/api-doctor/index.md): Concise English and Chinese product facts, supported protocols, privacy, billing and limitations.
- [Source and user documentation](https://github.com/hefu-hk/hefu-api-doctor/blob/main/README.md): Setup, development, build and usage documentation.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/hefu-hk/hefu-api-doctor/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Browser-only OAuth, diagnostic and report design.
- [Validation record](https://github.com/hefu-hk/hefu-api-doctor/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): Test coverage and production acceptance evidence.
- [HeFu API documentation](https://hefu.hk/docs): Public API and OAuth integration documentation.
